supplementalProfiles.config: Pinned series manifest v1 through v6, readiness and one bound step request; v6 binds H06/2 materials and an H06/3 package per H06 slot
env: Repository dependencies and pinned scenario runtime inputs
Separate exact native/service/model authorization for each H01–H06 step; no series grant is inferred
output: Bound series ledger, immutable pending/result evidence and scenario-specific operator evidence
supplementalProfiles.limits: Versions 1–5 retain their four-slot increments; v6 binds the full 24-run schedule. Plan/status are read-only. Each --step needs its own exact authorization. H06 --reconcile appends a verified full-usage receipt, checks external turns and STOP and can open the next slot within the same cap. FAIL, unresolved UNKNOWN and unconfirmed STOP block advancement. Local reconciliation has no qualification effect.

supplementalProfiles.limits: Closed H02 scenario uses the shared interval/keeper/native guard. H01 grants are rejected. Local unit providers do not qualify live Codex, SDK lifecycle or installed consumers; native qualification remains pending.

supplementalProfiles.config: Pinned H03 operator spec and executionVersion2 request; own exact H03 primary grant and separately completed root recovery notices for candidate --run
env: Repository development dependencies; plan/prepare/issue-recovery do not start services or models
--run separately requires exact primary H03 grant, native Codex and local Temporal service for candidate
output: Pinned drafts or one owned H03 attempt with native compaction, observed LOAD, retained FAIL/pending, accounting and STOP proof
supplementalProfiles.limits: Closed H03 uses one same-session native compact with a separate reservation and primary usage barrier. Unsupported compaction is NOT RUN; UNKNOWN blocks retry. Human pause/resume notices cannot be fabricated or replaced by initial-grant authority. Unit doubles do not qualify native execution or full series.

supplementalProfiles.config: Pinned H04 operator spec and executionVersion2 request; own exact H04 primary grant for --run
env: Repository development dependencies; plan/prepare do not start services or models
--run separately requires exact primary H04 grant, native Codex and local Temporal service for candidate
output: Pinned drafts or one owned H04 attempt with primary native wait, operation/result/application, accounting and STOP evidence
supplementalProfiles.limits: Closed H04 keeps operation and application at the host owner. Native access remains read-only. One launch and exactly one terminal wait must be linked to the original native turn and primary operation receipts. Unit doubles and the model-free helper do not qualify native execution or full series.

supplementalProfiles.config: Pinned H05 spec/request, identity generation at least 2 and own exact H05 primary grant for --run
env: Repository dependencies; plan/prepare do not start services or models
--run separately requires exact primary H05 grant, native Codex and local Temporal service for candidate
output: One known native turn, original primary history, separate transport interventions, retained waiting state, physical restart, accounting and STOP evidence
supplementalProfiles.limits: Closed H05 reuses the existing completion owner. Recovery never repeats create/send or reopens a sealed participant. Restart preserves owner/generation; stale generation and late cancelled results are refused. Unit doubles do not qualify native recovery, active grants or full series.
